description: ROW contract for popstats.tsv (one row per window per candidate). Per-window population-genetic summaries: nucleotide diversity (pi), between-arrangement divergence (dxy), an arrangement-FST-like contrast (H1 vs H2 partition), the inbreeding coefficient HWE_FIS, and observed / expected heterozygosity. Names are disciplined: arrangement_FST_like (not bare FST — the partition is by inferred arrangement), HWE_FIS (the summary is at the FIS level).
question: Q6

pi.description: Nucleotide diversity per site, all samples.

dxy_H1_H2.description: Per-site dxy between H1 and H2 arrangement carriers.

arrangement_FST_like.description: FST-like contrast between H1 and H2 arrangement carriers; named '_like' because the partition is by inferred arrangement rather than declared populations.
